clue.text: New, simple key in parts given to piano and organ

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

C major, with no sharps or flats, is the simplest key, so C

explanation.surface: Instructions for an arranger handing new, easy-key parts to the piano and the church organ.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organ' looks musical alongside piano, but it is the body's gland. N and C go inside AREAS to make ANCREAS, then P leads.
explanation.definitionFit: The pancreas is a gland, one of the body's internal organs, producing insulin and digestive enzymes.

clue.text: Report of a sailor's attack

parts.note: a salt is an old sailor, so a salt's

explanation.definitionFit: An assault is a violent attack, as a noun or verb.

clue.text: Start of culture shock for each boy meeting leader

a son is a boy child

explanation.definitionFit: A chairperson leads a meeting or committee, so is its leader.

clue.text: Each European leads greatly

indicators.note: the European letter goes in front of the next piece

parts.note: very means greatly, to a high degree

explanation.definitionFit: Every and each both pick out all members of a group one by one.

clue.text: Residence for Californians, unusually large in loose jeans

explanation.walkthrough: 'Residence' tempts as a house, but it is a whole city where Californians reside; 'loose' is the anagram signal and 'in' the container.
explanation.definitionFit: San Jose is a large Californian city, so a place where Californians live.

clue.text: Floury pudding taken by monarch is rabbit

parts.note: duff is a stiff flour pudding, as in plum duff

explanation.surface: The king eats a stodgy pudding made with rabbit.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang a rabbit is a poor or incompetent player, especially at cricket or golf; 'rabbit' tempts as a pie filling.
explanation.definitionFit: A duffer is an incompetent person, and a rabbit is British slang for an inept player.

clue.text: Not so clever, limiting broadband company's distribution mechanism

explanation.definitionFit: A dispenser is a machine or device that hands out items, a mechanism for distribution.

clue.text: Someone opposing environmentalists

definitions.meaning: an enemy or adversary who stands against you
Friends of the Earth, the green campaign group, abbreviated by its initials

explanation.definitionFit: A foe is an enemy, and FoE is the initialism of Friends of the Earth.

clue.text: Aged men shuffling when there are few men left

definitions.text: when there are few men left

indicators.note: shuffling mixes things up, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Elderly men shuffling along at the end, when few are left standing.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'men' are chess pieces: the endgame is the stage of a chess game when few remain on the board.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess the endgame is the final phase, played after most pieces have been exchanged off.

clue.text: Misread a nod, has he? Seek to give the opposite signal

indicators.note: to misread is to take something wrongly, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone who misunderstood a nod asks whether to signal the reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaking one's head signals no, the opposite of the yes given by a nod.

clue.text: What's sought in excavation

definitions.meaning: the prey or target someone is hunting for
an open pit from which stone is dug

explanation.definitionFit: A quarry is both a hunted animal or target and a pit where stone is extracted.

explanation.definitionFit: An ulster is a heavy belted overcoat, so it is an example of the garment.

clue.text: Particular example of protein in milk and spit?

parts.note: casein is the main protein found in milk
a spit is a narrow point of land running into the sea

explanation.surface: A specific instance of milk protein being spat out.
explanation.definitionFit: A case in point is an instance that illustrates the matter under discussion.

clue.text: Trustworthy condition of support ropes aboard ship

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship
a tee supports a golf ball
lines are ropes on a ship

clue.text: Stormy augmentation converting river to lake

parts.note: an increment is an increase or augmentation

explanation.definitionFit: Inclement weather is harsh, cold or stormy.

clue.text: Duck to baste, perhaps around medium

M is the abbreviation for medium, as on clothing sizes

explanation.walkthrough: 'baste' looks like kitchen work but here is tacking with stitches.
explanation.definitionFit: The smew is a small diving duck of the merganser family.

clue.text: Prods judge when incarcerating bishop

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.definitionFit: Jabs are quick sharp pokes or thrusts, which is what prods are.

clue.text: Borne up by James I, no Gaels worry a lot

the letters are carried by the words that follow, sitting inside them

explanation.walkthrough: The run ESINOGA sits in 'James I, no Gaels'; 'Borne up' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: To agonise is to worry intensely or deliberate with anguish.

clue.text: Astronomer's company causing harm when Io's not visible

explanation.definitionFit: Nicolaus Copernicus was the astronomer who placed the sun at the centre of the solar system.

clue.text: I am beset with stick in pursuit

clue.text: Immoral article supporting family friend?

an is the indefinite article

explanation.definitionFit: Unclean in a moral sense means impure or sinful, so immoral.

clue.text: Noble legion's not large

explanation.definitionFit: A countess is a noblewoman, the wife of an earl or count.

clue.text: Covering inverted hat, prepared with woollen fabric

clue.text: Being sent off stops departure
